verdict.rationale: Analysts can close a case with a 'no risk detected' decision, which resolves a false positive. Cases and alerts can be remediated in the Mesh web app or via the API. A case audit-trail endpoint returns the log for each case. Override is documented only as human review or override of AI agent decisions on the Starter plan, and reopening a decided case is never described. Missing for 10: documented reopening of a closed or decided case, override of a human analyst's prior decision, confirmation that override and reopen actions are written to the audit trail, and hands-on corroboration.
